title: 第722章 星级选手红菱第721章 当众测境
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
观众席上。
所有人都呆愣在原地，瞠目结舌。
他们被测境罗盘的结果，给整懵逼了。
这个结果。
他们难以相信，也无法接受。
洛星凝，竟然只有一星主宰境……
然而。
众人不知道的是。
测境罗盘的下限，是一星主宰境。
而不是落星凝的境界，是一星主宰境。
如果他们得知，洛星凝的境界，甚至还没有达到主宰境时。
那场面。
简直难以想象。
“这不可能！”
“你！”
“你怎么可能只有一星主宰境？！”
“这不合理！”
瘦小男子厉声大喝。
他可是借了几千万源晶，压落星凝会输。
眼前的结果，让他完全不能接受。

“没有什么不可能。”
“事实就摆在你们面前。”
“测境罗盘，你也亲自检查过，没有问题。”
“你相信与否，都跟我无关。”
“我只想知道，这一场擂台赛，可以宣布结果了吗？”
话落。
洛星凝转过头，看向鬼算子的方向。
鬼算子回过神来，随即郑声宣告道：
“测境罗盘的结果，诸位也都看到了。”
“寒星的境界，没有任何的问题。”
“我宣布！”
“本场擂台赛的获胜者是，凡组寒星！”
随着鬼算子的声音落下。
众人皆是露出一脸的无奈之色。
他们虽然很不甘心。
但事实就摆在他们眼前，容不得他们不信。
“踏马的，今天真是见鬼了！”
“一星主宰境，竟然战胜了七星主宰境……”
“这还是人吗？”
content_en:
In the audience.
Everyone froze on the spot, dumbfounded.
They were completely confused by the results of the compass.
This result.
They couldn't believe it and couldn't accept it.
Luo Xingning actually only has one star in the realm of domination...
However.
What everyone doesn’t know is.
The lower limit of the realm measuring compass is the one-star domination realm.
Rather than the realm of Luo Xing Ning, it is the realm of One Star Domination.
If they knew that Luo Xingning's realm had not even reached the realm of domination.
That scene.
It's unimaginable.
"This is impossible!"
"You!"
"How can you only have one star to dominate the realm?!"
"This is unreasonable!"
The thin man shouted loudly.
He had borrowed tens of millions of source crystals, so Xingluo Xingning would lose.
The result before him was completely unacceptable to him.
"Nothing is impossible."
"The facts are before you."
"You have also checked the situation measuring compass yourself. There is nothing wrong with it."
"Whether you believe it or not, it has nothing to do with me."
"I just want to know, can the result of this arena match be announced?"
The words fell.
Luo Xingning turned her head and looked in the direction of the ghost teller.
The ghost teller came back to his senses, and then solemnly declared:
"Everyone has seen the results of the realm measuring compass."
"With Han Xing's realm, there are no problems."
"I declare!"
"The winner of this arena competition is Fan Hanxing!"
As the ghost teller's voice fell.
Everyone looked helpless.
Although they are very unwilling.
But the facts are right in front of them, and they cannot tolerate disbelief.
"It's really a hell today for you to step on a horse!"
"The one-star domination realm actually defeated the seven-star domination realm..."
"Is this still a human being?"
